scripts.scope: Source-reasoned finite interaction script; no execution or success assertion.
scripts.intended_objective: Attempt one reservation-backed delivery while peers wait; no all-cargo completion claim.

paired_intervention_hypotheses.scope: Single actor-action component intervention with identical prefix, seed, remaining requests and branch length. No rollout or seed search.
paired_intervention_hypotheses.intended_difference: Source hypothesis: train 0 reservation of central block persists through two wait steps and changes train 1 nearest-block claim/toggle mask and public reservation observations. No effect magnitude or realized legality result is asserted.

limits: All scripts and delay choices are original source reasoning, not simulations. Primary script legality is an unexecuted hypothesis. Paired requests can become masked on one branch; record that unchanged. No seed search, execution, learned policy, success, measured effect, transfer or browser acceptance.
